item.title: Muslim Author Sues xAI Over Grok Hijab‑Stripping Abuse
item.description: Amani Al‑Khatahtbeh sues xAI, claiming Grok’s AI tool created non‑consensual sexual images that stripped her hijab, prompting worldwide legal action.

item.title: California Vetoes Bill Banning Secret Recording Glasses
item.description: Gov. Newsom vetoes SB 1130, stopping the first U.S. law to criminalize hidden‑recording wearables and igniting a privacy‑tech regulatory debate.
